notice.title: Legal notice
notice.seoDescription: Legal notice for eternatech.net: publisher, hosting provider, intellectual property and liability.

sections.title: Website publisher
sections.body: eternatech.net is published by Eterna Tech (Eternal Technologies), a technology solutions company based at I2E Student Center, Office No. 3, University of Tlemcen, Tlemcen 13000, Algeria. Phone: +213 659 793 110. Email: contact@eternatech.net. Full statutory identification details (legal form, registration number, share capital, publishing manager) are to be completed by Eterna Tech before launch.

sections.title: Hosting
sections.body: The site runs on a Vercel-compatible infrastructure with CDN delivery. The final hosting provider and its contact details will be stated once the hosting choice is confirmed.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: All website content — text, visuals, logos, the Eterna Tech and Amane Trig trademarks, source code — is protected. Any reproduction or representation, in whole or in part, without prior written permission from Eterna Tech is prohibited.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body: Eterna Tech strives to publish accurate and up-to-date information but does not guarantee that content is exhaustive. Links to third-party websites are provided for convenience; Eterna Tech has no control over their content.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For any question about this website or this legal notice, write to contact@eternatech.net.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.seoDescription: Eterna Tech privacy policy: data collected, purposes, retention periods, cookies and your rights.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: Contact form: full name, email address, phone and company (both optional), subject and message. Newsletter sign-up: email address. Audience measurement: aggregated browsing data, only after you give consent.

sections.title: Purposes
sections.body: Your data is used solely to answer your enquiry, to send you our news if you asked for it, and to improve the website. It is never sold or passed to third parties for advertising purposes.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Contact enquiries are kept for 24 months after the last exchange. Newsletter email addresses are kept until you unsubscribe. Browsing statistics are kept for a maximum of 14 months.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: No measurement or tracking cookie is installed before you agree. Only strictly necessary cookies (language preference, memory of your consent choice) are set by default. The Google Maps map loads only after third-party cookies are accepted.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: The site is served over HTTPS only, with security headers (CSP, HSTS) and spam protection on forms. Access to received messages is restricted to authorised Eterna Tech staff.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction or deletion of your data, or object to its processing, by writing to contact@eternatech.net. We reply within 30 days at most.
